# CG Master Academy

> > Online education platform offering professional courses in game art, concept art, VFX, 3D modeling, and animation taught by industry veterans from Pixar, Industrial Light & Magic, and other leading studios.

CG Master Academy (CGMA) provides specialized training across multiple disciplines including character design, environment design, Houdini, and 3D animation. The academy operates on a four-term academic calendar with 12-week courses taught by working professionals from major entertainment studios.

## Key Topics

- Game Art & Design
- Concept Art
- VFX Training
- 3D Modeling
- Character Design
- Environment Design
- Animation
- Houdini
- Industry Professionals
- Pixar
- Industrial Light & Magic
- Online Courses
- CG Art Training
- 12-Week Terms

## Main Site

- [CG Master Academy - Online Courses in Art, Games & VFX](https://www.cgmasteracademy.com/): Homepage for CGMA online courses in art, games, VFX with fall enrollment

## Course Categories

- [Game Art Courses](https://gameart.cgmasteracademy.com/): Game art courses subdomain featuring character and environment design
- [Concept Art Courses](https://conceptart.cgmasteracademy.com/): Concept art courses subdomain with Pixar and ILM industry professionals
